subject: CAIQ evidence: artifact stewardship and QA lane
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@nimbussys.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@nimbussys.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake — artifact custody + QA lane

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We (Nimbus Systems security) are preparing our procurement review and need a CAIQ crosswalk plus supporting artifacts that demonstrate live evidence for the following control set: ID.GV-2, IAM-5, LOG-3, CR-1, and KMS-rotation proofs for tenant-bound keys. Our vendor assessment window is tight — can you provide a draft mapping and a candidate evidence package by Friday 2027-09-24 EOD PST?

What we need from Redwood:
- Completed CAIQ answers for the controls above (explicit rationale where a control is not applicable)
- For each claim, one representative artifact (log extract, runbook excerpt, signed attestation, or screenshot) and a link or attachment to it
- KMS rotation record for tenant key used in private deploys (rotation timestamp + auditor hash)
- A short QA checklist (2–3 items) you use to validate exports before handing to customers

We understand not everything will be productionized; a sample that proves the pattern is fine as long as it comes from recent (last 90 days) data.

Emily
Emily Zhou
Security Operations, Nimbus Systems

Hi Emily —

Appreciate the clarity and the deadline. We can meet the 9/24 EOD ask with a draft package that contains: a CAIQ mapping sheet, an evidence manifest that points to short extracts or redacted screenshots, and a KMS rotation proof excerpt (redacted where appropriate).

Plan:
1) Kim will pull the runtime log sample and the LOG-3 extract (redacted token ids)
2) Jonas will assemble the CAIQ mapping rows and the rationale for any N/A answers
3) I will package the evidence manifest and run the QA checklist, then upload a zip for secure transfer.

Please confirm whether we can upload to the Drive link you shared, or if Nimbus prefers a signed DocuSignized transfer for the KMS artifact.

Deliverables (target 2027-09-24 17:00 PST):
- CAIQ_Response_Draft_v1.xlsx (mapping + narrative)
- evidence_manifest_8721.csv (artifact pointers + owner)
- kms_rotation_proof.pdf (redacted proof)
- caqi_evidence_package_20270924.zip (secure upload link)

Marissa

Kim / Marissa,

Confirmed: we can share the KMS rotation timestamp and the auditor hash as long as the raw key material and full key IDs are redacted. That will satisfy Nimbus's procurement team and maintain our key secrecy requirements.

Two small asks for the QA lane:
- Add a checksum column to the evidence_manifest for each artifact (SHA256) so recipients can verify integrity after download.
- Include the exact scope statement at the top of the CAIQ sheet (tenant-scoped: "nimbus-prod-1" only; no cross-tenant data).

I'll sign off on kms_rotation_proof.pdf once the redaction layer is applied; please ping me for a final review.

Rishi

Emily / Nimbus team,

Per the timeline, attached is our draft CAIQ response and a bundled evidence package. Highlights:
- CAIQ_Response_Draft_v1.xlsx: mapping rows for the requested controls with tenant-scoped rationale and a short QA checklist at the top.
- evidence_manifest_8721.csv: artifact pointers, SHA256 checksums, owner, and sample redaction notes.
- kms_rotation_proof.pdf: rotation timestamp + auditor hash (key ids redacted).
- caqi_evidence_package_20270924.zip: contains redacted log extracts and screenshots.

A couple of policy notes:
- All artifacts provided are tenant-scoped to "nimbus-prod-1" and sampled from August–September 2027 windows.
- If Nimbus needs raw logs or full key IDs for an independent audit, we request a signed NDA amendment and a controlled transfer process (we can route via an SFTP + temporary role).

Please review and tell us if you want the CAIQ answers styled differently (short answers + footnoted evidence, or full narrative cells). We can finalize and push a second pass after your feedback.

Thanks —
Marissa
